Every worksheet is free, needs no sign-up, and prints on A4 or US Letter. Each sheet’s page keeps everything in reach: the artwork, the download and print buttons, and a place for families to react and comment.

FOR GROWN-UPS

How the library works.

Each worksheet belongs to a class on the Learning Path. The page for every worksheet shows its artwork, a Download Free Worksheet button (a real PDF file) and a Print Worksheet button that opens the same PDF ready to print — never the website around it.

Downloading or printing never marks anything complete in My Classroom — worksheets are for tables, kitchens and fridge doors. Only the games save progress, and only for the child chosen there.
